! Background:
The topic of motivation, effects, and therapeutic potentials of a specific intervention or phenomenon is a complex and multifaceted area of study. Motivation is a fundamental aspect of human behavior, influencing an individual's goals, actions, and overall well-being. The effects of motivation on physical and mental health, relationships, and overall quality of life are well-documented, and understanding these effects is crucial for developing effective interventions and therapies.

! Rationale:
The dissertation project aims to provide an in-depth examination of the motivations, effects, and therapeutic potentials of a specific intervention or phenomenon. This research will contribute to the existing body of knowledge in the field by:

! Improve our understanding of human motivation and its effects on physical and mental health

! Enhance our ability to support individuals in achieving their goals and improving their overall well-being
! Contribute to the advancement of knowledge in the field of motivation and its applications in various domains, including education, healthcare, and business

The dissertation project will employ a mixed-methods approach, combining both qualitative and quantitative methods to gather and analyze data. The research design will involve:
